channel.title: Services on KubeSphere
channel.description: Recent content in Services on KubeSphere

item.title: Create Stateful or Stateless Services
item.description: This section describes how to create stateful or stateless services in a federated project. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace. Steps Refer to Parameter Description to set the service parameters.

item.title: View Service List
item.description: This section describes how to view the service list. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project View permission in the corresponding workspace. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Federated Project View permissions and enter your federated project.

item.title: View Service Details
item.description: This section describes how to view service details. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project View permission in the corresponding workspace. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Federated Project View permissions and enter your federated project.

item.title: Edit Service Information
item.description: This section describes how to edit Job information. You can edit the alias and description of a Job. KubeSphere does not support editing the name of a created Job. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace.

item.title: Edit Service Settings
item.description: This section describes how to edit Job settings. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace. Steps Log in to the KubeSphere web console as a user with Federated Project Management permissions and enter your federated project.

item.title: Edit Service External Access Settings
item.description: This section describes how to edit the service external access settings. Note This operation is only supported for services with the internal access mode set to VirtualIP. It is not supported for services with the internal access modes Headless or ExternalName. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension must be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform.

item.title: Delete Service
item.description: This section describes how to delete a service. Warning After deleting the service, you will not be able to access the pods behind it. Please perform this operation with caution. Prerequisites The Application Management for Cluster Federation extension needs to be installed and enabled on the KubeSphere platform. You need to join a federated project and have the Federated Project Management permission in the corresponding workspace.
